final: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS apic, AVG(HGB)*1.0/AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) <> 0), m AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mr FROM p) SELECT AVG(p.apic) AS avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - m.mr) AS avg_excess FROM p, m WHERE p.ratio > m.mr
